# Scripts

This layer contains scripts used for building, packaging, and releasing the software project.

## Overview

Contains plugins for building and serving WOFF2 fonts using ESBuild and Vite.

## Responsibilities

- **Package Scripts**: Scripts for creating distributable packages.

| File | Purpose | Main definitions |

## How it works

- `build-base.js`: Sets up the build environment, including configuration and environment-specific builds.
- `build-node.js`: Builds the project for Node.js, requiring Cairo to be installed on your machine.
- `build-version.js`: Generates version information, including the date, commit hash, and commit date.
- `build-package.js`: Packages the software for distribution, resolving relative paths and precompiling necessary files.
- `update-changelog.js`: Updates the changelog based on commit history since the last release.

## Configuration

- Configuration files: `.eslintrc.json`, `.npmrc`, `Dockerfile`, `docker-compose.yml`, `packages/excalidraw/locales/percentages.json`, `tsconfig.json`, `vitest.config.mts`.
